summary.name: Daily Wallpaper
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source macOS menu bar app that sets a daily Bing photo as the desktop and lock screen wallpaper.
use_cases: Refresh the Mac desktop with a new Bing photo every few hours
Keep the lock screen matching the desktop wallpaper
Pick wallpaper categories such as landscapes, cities, beaches or space
Run a lightweight wallpaper changer from the command line instead of an app
summary.what_it_does: Daily Wallpaper is a small menu bar app for macOS that fetches photos from Bing and sets one as the desktop wallpaper. Users choose one or more categories (landscapes, cities and architecture, beaches and islands, animals and wildlife, space and night sky, or everything). The change interval can be every 1, 3, 6, 12 or 24 hours, or manual only, and it also refreshes when the Mac wakes. The lock screen can be kept on the same photo by setting the wallpaper once with Show on all Spaces enabled. It queries several Bing markets, keeps only the current photo on disk, and states that its only network calls go to bing.com. A shell-script version in a cli/ folder offers the same types and schedule.
notable: Keeps the lock screen on the same photo as the desktop when set with Show on all Spaces
Under 5 MB with no Electron, web views or helper daemons
Optional shell-script CLI version (bingwall) with the same categories and schedule
No account, no analytics, MIT licensed
caveats: The app is unsigned, so macOS requires right-click then Open on first launch
Lock screen sync needs a one-time manual setup in Wallpaper Settings
